name: impact-trace-demo
description: A sample Next.js storefront used to demonstrate ImpactTrace carbon estimation across user journeys.
author: Ashley Ward

scripts.impact:home: npm run reports:dir && impact-trace run --url http://localhost:3100/ --output reports/home.json
scripts.impact:compare: npm run reports:dir && impact-trace run --url http://localhost:3100/products --url http://localhost:3100/legacy/products --output reports/compare.json
scripts.impact:journey:optimised: npm run reports:dir && impact-trace run impact-trace/journeys/optimisedCheckout.ts --compare-cache --output reports/journey-optimised.json
scripts.impact:journey:legacy: npm run reports:dir && impact-trace run impact-trace/journeys/legacyCheckout.ts --compare-cache --output reports/journey-legacy.json
scripts.impact:journey:browse: npm run reports:dir && impact-trace run impact-trace/journeys/browseCatalogue.ts --output reports/journey-browse.json
scripts.impact:all: npm run impact:journey:optimised && npm run impact:journey:legacy && npm run impact:journey:browse
